stem.en-US: When building a linear regression model, the training error is small but the [[term:test-set|test error]] is large. What is the most likely cause?

explanation.zh-CN: [[term:training-set|训练误差]]小、[[term:test-set|测试误差]]大是[[term:overfitting|过拟合]]的典型特征，代表模型[[term:generalization|泛化能力]]不足。
explanation.en-US: A small [[term:training-set|training error]] and large [[term:test-set|test error]] are typical signs of [[term:overfitting|overfitting]], indicating poor [[term:generalization|generalization]].
